comments.author: Igor
comments.body: "Extreme eastern end of the Gulf of Finland" might have been more helpful. The thing to remember is that sturgeon--both the Baltic and the beluga in the Black Sea--are freshwater fish, so theoretically, as a UWO player, you're catching them in river estuaries. So you have to be really close to the coast.
